title: Scientific Programme
text:
Hosted by
      
    
  
  Joint Two-day Meeting 2026
  
  
    The Danish Society for Statistics (DSTS) and the Danish Society
    for Biopharmaceutical Statistics (DSBS) invite you to a two-day scientific
    meeting spanning causal inference, clinical trials, 
    survival analysis, and AI, hosted by Novo Nordisk.
